Title: Stream Analytics: Parallel SQL write operations

Body.Content: Azure Stream Analytics now supports high-performance and efficient write operations to Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Data Warehouse to help customers achieve four to five times higher throughput than what was previously possible. To achieve fully parallel topologies, Stream Analytics will transition SQL writes from serial to parallel operations while simultaneously allowing for batch size customizations.
